```plato
//==
// # Enriched point clouds
//
// Unstructured 3D sample sets carrying per-point channels — normals, colors,
// and sensor attributes — as produced by scanning, LiDAR, and photogrammetry.
// Every channel array is parallel to Positions. The bare, position-only clouds
// are in `meshes.types.plato`.

// A point cloud carrying a unit normal per point: the input to surface
// reconstruction (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surface_reconstruction) and
// oriented splatting. Positions and Normals are parallel.
type OrientedPointCloud3D
    implements IValue, IPointCloud3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Normals: Array<Direction3D>;
}
```
